tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and the floor-plan sheet. The cyanotype blue everything sits on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the planner panel. One step off paper, never shadowed.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: the video slot, inputs, the title block on the sheet.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Minor drafting grid (20px). Decorative only, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Major drafting grid (100px) and zone hatching.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, machine outlines, dividers, dimension lines. 3:1+ on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: Structural walls and doors on the plan; the heaviest stroke in the system.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, annotations, machine codes. 4.5:1+ on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Carolina blue. Selected chips, primary buttons, muscle-match fill on the plan. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter amber. The ONE machine currently hovered or selected, 'you are here', and placeholder flags. Never more than one thing at a time besides flags.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text placed on highlight.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Body fill of a machine outline that matches the planner; its strokes turn accent.

tokens.name: highlight-wash
tokens.usage: Body fill of the selected machine outline; its strokes turn highlight.

tokens.name: zone-fill
tokens.usage: Faint wash inside a gym zone on the plan, under the hatching.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title on the landing view. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Machine name in the machine card, split names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep your chest tall and pull the bar to your upper chest.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Supporting lines under titles, chip text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Zone names, section eyebrows. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Machine codes on markers and cards; the link between the plan and the list.

styles.name: dimension
styles.usage: Title block, scale bar, north arrow. Decoration that reads like a drawing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip inner gap, icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Plan zones, walls, the sheet. Drawings are square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Machine markers, cards, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Muscle chips only.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Card borders, grid, machine outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-mid
tokens.usage: Hovered / selected machine outline, focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-wall
tokens.usage: Exterior and structural walls on the plan.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Machines that do NOT match the chosen muscle group while the planner filter is on.
